# Results — Study 98 (High-Noon) on the real total-return tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). One recipe — flag every day
whose close is within **1%** of the **running all-time high** (total-return high), then
compare the forward **1 / 3 / 12-month** total returns of those days against the days
**not** near a high (means with HAC *t*-stats, win-rates with Wilson 95% intervals, and a
HAC test of the **difference**). Then the folk rule taken literally: an **avoid-the-highs**
timer — invested only when NOT at an ATH, in cash (earning **0%**) otherwise, acting one
day after the flag, **5 bps** per switch — against buy-and-hold. Run on the **total-return**
SPY tape. As-of **2026-06-12**; match the fingerprint to confirm you hold the same tape.*

| Series | Window | Rows | Fingerprint |

## The decisive numbers

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| 1-month forward return: at-ATH vs not | −0.42 pts, HAC *t* = **−1.34** (not significant) |
| 3-month forward return: at-ATH vs not | −0.31 pts, HAC *t* = **−0.36** (not significant) |
| 12-month forward return: at-ATH vs not | **+1.44 pts**, HAC *t* = **+0.38** (mildly *higher*, not significant) |
| Is buying at an ATH bearish? | **No** — no horizon shows a significant *negative* difference |
| Avoid-highs timer CAGR vs buy-and-hold | **−1.70 pts/yr** (9.12% vs 10.82%) |
| Avoid-highs timer Sharpe vs buy-and-hold | **−0.066** (0.580 vs 0.646) |
| Final wealth | **0.60×** buy-and-hold |

## How to read it

- **An all-time high is not a sell signal.** Forward returns after an ATH are
  statistically indistinguishable from forward returns when *not* near a high — every
  horizon's difference sits inside the noise band (|HAC *t*| < 2). At 12 months the
  at-ATH arm is actually *higher* (+1.44 pts), and its win-rate (84.6%) *beats* the
  not-at-ATH win-rate (80.5%), Wilson intervals non-overlapping. Highs cluster in
  uptrends, and uptrends keep trending. → 3rd axis **BUSTED**; Signal **NONE**.
- **"Avoid the highs" loses to just holding.** Sitting out 29% of the tape — the best
  trending days — costs **1.7 pts/yr**, a lower Sharpe, and leaves you with **0.60×** the
  wealth, all for *no* drawdown relief (−54.7% vs −55.2%). → Tradability **MIRAGE**.
